Get Live AQI Data for a Station

Source: R/cpcb_live.r
cpcb_get_live_aqi_data_for_station.Rd

Get live AQI data for a specific station at a specific time.

Usage

cpcb_get_live_aqi_data_for_station(station_id, date_time)

Arguments

station_id

Station ID

date_time

Date and time in 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:00:00Z' format

Value

List with live AQI data
